+#!/usr/bin/python3
+"""
+Example usage and output
+
+./seeded-snaps-new-release.py --manifest-url $URL --from-release "25.10" --to-release "26.04"
+...
+...
+...
+^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
+desktop-security-center | 1/stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+firefox | stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+firmware-updater | 1/stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+gnome-42-2204 | stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+gtk-common-themes | stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+prompting-client | 1/stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+snap-store | 2/stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+snapd-desktop-integration | stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+thunderbird | stable/ubuntu-25.10 | FAILED
+"""
+
+import requests
+import argparse
+import tempfile
+import subprocess
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--manifest-url",
+        type=str,
+        required=True,
+        help="Point to manifest url for desktop image for 'from' release",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--from-release", type=str, required=True, help="series version FROM"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--to-release", type=str, required=True, help="series version TO"
+    )
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def download_file_to_str(file_url):
+    r = requests.get(file_url)
+    return r.content.decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def get_snap_data_from_manifest(manifest):
+    snap_data = {}
+    for m_line in manifest.splitlines():
+        # We ignore ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap as there is a
+        # fallback mechanism for this snap, if the new release
+        # track doesn't yet exist, any images will just use the
+        # previous release track. Desktop team is also on top of this
+        # track opening.
+        if m_line.startswith("snap:ubuntu-desktop-bootstrap"):
+            continue
+        if m_line.startswith("snap:"):
+            snap_line = m_line.replace("snap:", "")
+            snap_name = snap_line.split("\t")[0]
+            snap_channel = snap_line.split("\t")[1]
+            snap_revision = snap_line.split("\t")[2]
+            snap_data[snap_name] = {
+                "channel": snap_channel,
+                "revision": snap_revision,
+            }
+    return snap_data
+
+
+def create_snap_test_commands(snap_data, old_release, new_release, target_dir):
+    new_snap_data = snap_data
+    base_cmd = "snap download $SNAP --channel $CHANNEL"
+    commands = []
+    for key, value in snap_data.items():
+        new_channel = value["channel"].replace(old_release, new_release)
+        # commands.append(f"snap download {key} --channel {new_channel} --target-directory={target_dir}")
+        new_snap_data[key][
+            "command"
+        ] = f"snap download {key} --channel {new_channel} --target-directory={target_dir}"
+    return new_snap_data
+
+
+def print_failures(snap_data_w_cmds):
+    for key, value in snap_data_w_cmds.items():
+        if value["result"] == "FAILED":
+            print(f"{key} | {value['channel']} | {value['result']}")
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    manifest_file = download_file_to_str(args.manifest_url)
+    snap_data = get_snap_data_from_manifest(manifest_file)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdirname:
+        snap_data_w_cmds = create_snap_test_commands(
+            snap_data, args.from_release, args.to_release, tmpdirname
+        )
+        for key, value in snap_data_w_cmds.items():
+            dl_cmd = value["command"]
+            result = subprocess.run(dl_cmd.split(" "))
+            if result.returncode != 0:
+                snap_data_w_cmds[key]["result"] = "FAILED"
+            else:
+                snap_data_w_cmds[key]["result"] = "SUCCESS"
+    print("^" * 100)
+    print_failures(snap_data_w_cmds)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
